# Video Demo

![](qdraw.mp4)


# Installation

``` bash
quarto add mahmudstat/qdraw
```

and add the plugin to your `yaml` in the the following way:

``` yaml
---
title: "Qdraw Example"
format:
  revealjs: default
revealjs-plugins:
  - qdraw
---
```

## Updating

```bash
quarto update mahmudstat/qdraw
```

This pulls the latest version of the extension and overwrites your local `_extensions/qdraw` folder. See the [News](#/news) slide for what's changed in each version.

Then render the `qmd` afresh.

# Using

- Add your contents to `qmd` file and render.
- Click on the draw icon <i class="fas fa-pen-nib"></i> to activate the drawing tools.
- Click the icon again to hide the tools and move on to the other slides.
- Use the self-explanatory tools as per your requirements.

## Icons — Toolbar (Drawing) {#icons .smaller}

::: {.icon-table}
| Icon | Tool | What it does |
|:---:|---|---|
| <i class="fas fa-pen-nib"></i> | Toggle Drawing | Show or hide the whole toolbar |
| <i class="fas fa-marker"></i> | Pen | Switch to freehand pen drawing |
| <i class="fas fa-palette"></i> | Pen &amp; Shape Color | Choose the color used by the pen and by shapes |
| *(slider)* | Pen Size | Adjust pen stroke thickness |
| <i class="fas fa-undo"></i> | Undo | Undo the last stroke, shape, or erase on the current page |
| <i class="fas fa-eraser"></i> | Eraser | Open eraser options: freehand erase, select-area erase, delete all |
| *(slider)* | Eraser Size | Adjust the eraser's diameter |
:::

## Icons — Toolbar (Canvas & Navigation) {.smaller}

::: {.icon-table}
| Icon | Tool | What it does |
|:---:|---|---|
| <i class="fas fa-shapes"></i> | Shapes | Open shape options: line, rectangle, triangle, ellipse, circle, solid fill |
| <i class="fas fa-fill-drip"></i> | Background | Open background options: choose color, reset |
| <i class="fas fa-clone"></i> | Pages | Open page navigation: previous, next, add page |
| <i class="fas fa-download"></i> | Download | Save the current page as a PNG |
| <i class="fas fa-circle-info"></i> | About | Show a popover linking to the qdraw site |
| <i class="fas fa-right-left"></i> | Move Controls | Move the toolbar to the opposite screen edge (only shown while drawing tools are active) |
:::

## Icons — Eraser Options {.smaller}

::: {.icon-table}
| Icon | Option | What it does |
|:---:|---|---|
| <i class="fas fa-eraser"></i> | Eraser | Erase by dragging over strokes |
| <i class="fas fa-vector-square"></i> | Select &amp; Erase | Drag a rectangle to erase everything inside it |
| <i class="fas fa-trash"></i> | Delete All | Clear the entire current page |
:::

## Icons — Shape Options {.smaller}

::: {.icon-table}
| Icon | Option | What it does |
|:---:|---|---|
| <i class="fas fa-minus"></i> | Line | Draw a straight line |
| <i class="fas fa-square"></i> | Rectangle | Drag corner to corner |
| <i class="fas fa-play" style="transform: rotate(-90deg); display: inline-block;"></i> | Triangle | Drag corner to corner |
| <i class="fas fa-circle" style="transform: scaleX(1.6); display: inline-block;"></i> | Ellipse | Drag corner to corner |
| <i class="fas fa-circle"></i> | Circle | Drag from the center outward |
| <i class="fas fa-fill"></i> | Solid Fill | Toggle filled vs. outline shapes |
:::

## Icons — Background &amp; Page Options {.smaller}

::: {.icon-table}
| Icon | Option | What it does |
|:---:|---|---|
| <i class="fas fa-fill-drip"></i> | Choose Color | Pick a background color for the canvas |
| <i class="fas fa-rotate-left"></i> | Reset | Reset the background to default (transparent) |
| <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i> | Previous Page | Go to the previous drawing page |
| `1/2` | Page indicator | Shows current page / total pages |
| <i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i> | Next Page | Go to the next drawing page |
| <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> | Add Page | Create a new blank page and switch to it |
:::

# News

See the [Older versions](https://github.com/mahmudstat/qdraw#older-versions) section of the README for earlier changes.

## Version 1.5.2

- Lightened the pen/shape tool icon outline (added in 1.5.1) - it was rendering too thick

## Version 1.5.1

- The pen and shape tool icons now match the selected pen color, with an outline so they stay legible at any color
